defaults.architecture_story: A high-accuracy architecture is only shippable if its operators stay on the mobile accelerator fast path.

mobile_cnn.label: Mobile CNN / inverted residuals
mobile_cnn.summary: Locality and weight sharing fit mobile image workloads with broad NPU support.
mobile_cnn.validation_requirement: NPU operator-coverage check plus thermal soak
mobile_cnn.residual_risk: unlisted operators can silently fall back to CPU/GPU paths

efficient_transformer.label: Efficient mobile transformer
efficient_transformer.summary: Better global context but tighter kernel and activation margins.
efficient_transformer.scaling_law: resolution and token mixing increase memory pressure
efficient_transformer.residual_risk: context gains may disappear if attention kernels fall off accelerator

desktop_vit.label: Desktop-scale ViT
desktop_vit.summary: Higher nominal quality, but the resource signature is not mobile-shaped.
desktop_vit.scaling_law: token count drives attention and activation growth
desktop_vit.validation_requirement: reject unless redesigned for mobile kernels
desktop_vit.residual_risk: quality advantage is unusable under sustained local execution

defaults.architecture_story: A tiny architecture must treat the sensor window and activation buffer as first-class hardware constraints.

streaming_tcn.label: Streaming temporal CNN
streaming_tcn.summary: Causal temporal filters reuse a small buffer and preserve most signal context.
streaming_tcn.scaling_law: window length grows buffer and latency roughly linearly
streaming_tcn.residual_risk: short windows can miss slow physiology changes

tiny_cnn.label: Tiny DS-CNN
tiny_cnn.summary: Depthwise separable filters trade context for compact firmware and predictable kernels.
tiny_cnn.scaling_law: window and channel growth pressure SRAM
tiny_cnn.validation_requirement: firmware image and OTA payload check
tiny_cnn.residual_risk: feature extraction assumptions become part of the model boundary

micro_transformer.label: Micro transformer
micro_transformer.summary: Useful temporal context, but attention state is too expensive for a ring-class device.
micro_transformer.scaling_law: attention window has superlinear memory growth
micro_transformer.validation_requirement: reject unless attention state is externalized or compressed
micro_transformer.residual_risk: accuracy gain depends on unavailable memory and power headroom

defaults.architecture_story: A RoboTaxi model can be accurate on average and still be unsafe if its tail-latency shape is unbounded.

bounded_cnn_detector.label: Bounded CNN detector
bounded_cnn_detector.summary: Convolutional detector with predictable kernels and a clear safety replay envelope.
bounded_cnn_detector.scaling_law: sensor resolution grows convolutional feature maps
bounded_cnn_detector.validation_requirement: p99/p999 replay and rare-hazard recall regression
bounded_cnn_detector.residual_risk: small objects and unusual weather remain data-bound

hybrid_vit_detector.label: Hybrid ViT detector
hybrid_vit_detector.summary: Adds global context with a narrow tail-latency and activation margin.
hybrid_vit_detector.scaling_law: resolution and token mixing create a steep tail
hybrid_vit_detector.validation_requirement: burst sensor replay and fallback drill
hybrid_vit_detector.residual_risk: context modules can stretch p99 under sensor bursts

large_multimodal_transformer.label: Large multimodal transformer
large_multimodal_transformer.summary: Strong average reasoning signal, but the resource envelope is not vehicle-local bounded.
large_multimodal_transformer.scaling_law: tokens from multiple sensors drive memory and tail latency
large_multimodal_transformer.validation_requirement: reject for local loop unless split behind a safety fallback
large_multimodal_transformer.residual_risk: average quality hides unacceptable rare-event latency

defaults.architecture_story: Cloud makes larger architectures possible, but batch/context scaling still creates memory, latency, and cost walls.

bert_encoder.label: BERT-style encoder
bert_encoder.summary: Transformer encoder gives strong quality with mature kernels and controllable context.
bert_encoder.scaling_law: attention memory grows with context length squared
bert_encoder.residual_risk: long-context traffic can collapse batching efficiency

moe_transformer.label: Sparse MoE transformer
moe_transformer.summary: Higher capacity and quality, but routing and memory pressure complicate fleet economics.
moe_transformer.scaling_law: context and expert routing pressure HBM and tail latency
moe_transformer.validation_requirement: expert-routing skew test and cost/request canary
moe_transformer.residual_risk: fleet skew can strand capacity even when average utilization looks good

wide_cnn_classifier.label: Wide CNN text classifier
wide_cnn_classifier.summary: Cheap and fast, but its inductive bias underfits the language workload guardrail.
wide_cnn_classifier.scaling_law: mostly linear with context until receptive field saturates
wide_cnn_classifier.residual_risk: low cost hides unacceptable language-quality loss
